scope: Isolated Edge, local documents, synthetic credentials and mock vision; no real model accuracy claim.

results.name: Markdown roundtrip preserves escaped pipes, backslashes, blank cells and Unicode
Markdown table extraction keeps captions/footnotes and ignores code samples in both fence styles
TSV retains numeric strings, quotes multiline cells, pads missing fields and literalizes formulas
Plain prose or a chart description does not become a copyable table
Web native tables expose Markdown and TSV immediately, with repeated merged headers, caption and footnote and no AI
A 350-row native table is fully copyable without the former 300-row truncation
Native table display and TSV preserve literal Markdown punctuation, link syntax and HTML-like text
Markdown/TSV downloads contain the same table and TSV has a UTF-8 BOM
Clipboard denial exposes selected read-only manual copy text instead of claiming success
Native table expansion preserves rowSpan=0, line breaks and numeric text, and removes generated/hidden text
Image tables load locally and batch transcription is explicit, carries original pixels and faithful-data instructions
AI table results provide copy/download tools, preserve escaped pipes, and mark the transcription as unverified
Per-image transcription gives an honest no-table outcome without fabricating a table or keeping stale data
A later successful transcription replaces the empty result and can be copied again
Copy controls, table scrolling and results fit 390, 620 and 1440 pixel windows
Markdown reader extracts whole-document tables across paragraph/page splitting without AI
TXT supports text tables and replacing a document clears the prior table inventory
Word table cells are locally copyable through the shared document workflow
PDF whole-page capture uses the same explicit AI-to-copyable-table workflow
Stopping table transcription aborts HTTP, retains no stale prior table and permits retry
Code blocks remain inert and do not expose false table-copy controls
No uncaught browser errors
